name: PhD in Biological Sciences
detailsNote: The January 1 fall deadline is published without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The department page does not state GRE, letter counts, funding or how students are admitted, so those are left out or marked unknown.
summary: PhD in biological sciences at Northern Illinois University. The department strongly encourages applicants to contact potential faculty advisors before applying.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall admission deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The department page gives no year. Confirm the Fall 2027 date. It adds that full applications received after the deadline are reviewed only if space and funding are available.

english.note: NIU Graduate School minimums (PTE Academic 53; ELS level 112 also accepted). Not needed if you completed a bachelor's or higher degree in an eligible country listed on its page.

applicationFee.note: $60 for degree-seeking students. The Graduate School exempts only certain groups (for example McNair Scholars, qualified veterans, or those with a GRE fee reduction); it does not say international applicants qualify, so confirm.

documents: Proof of English proficiency, if applicable
requirements.note: Applicants need a four-year bachelor's degree and a 2.75 GPA on a 4.0 scale. Programs may require more; the department page does not state a letter count.

international.note: International applicants have earlier Graduate School deadlines (Fall: May 1).
